traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Aextoxicaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; stipules absent; plants dioecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in racemes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit drupe; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 5; carpels 2.
